what: check_chapter.js FAILS ch6 at both widths: the page's `data-same-src` badges mean 'same program except line 1', but the engine's `data-same-src` (comic-widgets.js:697) requires identical source, so the engine logs two console errors before the chapter script repaints the badge.
evidence: Checker: `FAIL javascript/ch6.html @1280px - [POLYGLOT.comic] widget=same-src error=sources differ: grade.js, grade_95.js, grade_72.js, grade_40.js` (and fall_lights.js … fall_smoke.js), same at 390. Learners see the chapter's text 'Same program on every road: only line 1 differs …' only because js-ch6.js runs later. engine.json's finding 'delete the [data-same-src] blocks from those extensions' lists js-ch6.js: doing that would turn both badges pink 'Sources differ'.
fix: Rename the chapter attribute so it no longer collides: `data-same-src` → `data-same-body` in ch6.html:288/810 and js-ch6.js `sameSrc()`; then exclude js-ch6.js from the engine-review deletion.

fix: `.ex-options { display: grid; gap: 8px }` → `… grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) }` plus `.ex-opt code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` (break-ui: one token longer than its container must not widen the row).

what: The verdict buttons are engine `.btn`s used as a toggle group, but the 'my pick' state is a 3px ink outline (`.vd-btn[aria-pressed=true]`) instead of the engine's toggle 'on' state. The outline looks like a focus ring, and after answering every button just goes flat and disabled.
evidence: Probe after a click: aria-pressed=true, outline 'rgb(17,17,17) solid 3px', background white, box-shadow none. js-ch8.css `.vd-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }`.
fix: `.vd-btn[aria-pressed=true] { outline: 3px solid ink }` → use `.path-btn` (engine toggle-group: filled plus the pressed shadow and a word such as '← my pick') (DESIGN_SYSTEM §3: don't hand-roll toggle states; outlines are reserved for :focus-visible).

what: Train-yard motion breaks the motion budget: each Next press runs `car-in 0.5s ease-out` (built-in curve) and `idx-pop 0.6s` with a scale(1.35) rotate(-8deg) overshoot on every renumbered index. Under reduced motion it's cut to `none` instead of the house 150ms fade.
evidence: Probe on ch9 stepping the yard: computed animation '0.5s ease-out car-in' and '0.6s ease-out idx-pop'. js-ch9.css: `.motion .car.is-new { animation: car-in 0.5s ease-out; }`, `@keyframes idx-pop { 40% { transform: scale(1.35) rotate(-8deg) } }`, `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { … animation: none }`. 'Animations: off' does stop both (motion class removed).
fix: `car-in 0.5s ease-out` → `car-in var(--dur-move) var(--ease-out) both`. `idx-pop 0.6s, scale(1.35) rotate(-8deg)` → `var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out)`, `scale(1.12)`, no rotation. Reduced motion: `animation: none` → `fade-in 150ms` (it fires on every Next and keyboard step, so it must stay under 300ms; reduced motion is gentler, not zero).
